inputs.text: [excited] Pa… rah… seh… RA… theer… ee… um. [curious] In Greek, "cerat" means horn, and the little piece in front means "without." [playful] Close to the beast... without a horn.
[happily] Almost — a cousin of the rhinoceros, yes, but without a single horn. [serious] Not a dinosaur: it showed up way later, [pauses] thirty million years ago.
[confident] In Asia — Pakistan, China, and Mongolia.
